questions: Should standardization be performed within each group separately (group-wise) or across the entire dataset (global)?
If standardization is group-wise, should each group's standardization be independent (fit only on that group's data) or should the scaler be fitted on all data but applied per group?
Should the output DataFrame include only the standardized 'age' and 'income' columns, or all original columns (including 'id' and any others)?
If there are NaN values in 'age' or 'income', should they be handled (e.g., imputed, dropped) or cause an error?
Should the function standardize 'age' and 'income' together as a 2D array (multivariate) or each column independently (univariate)?
What should happen if a group has only one row? Standardization of a single value is undefined (zero variance).
Should the function modify the input DataFrame in-place or return a new DataFrame?
If 'id' column contains non-numeric values (e.g., strings), should grouping still work?
